Chart/Grid line
Horizontal guide lines: grid, zero baseline and dashed target. 3 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
When to use
Solid: one per Y tick, behind marks.
Baseline: the zero line of bars and areas.
Target: a goal or plan value across the plot.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Grid lines sit behind the data and never compete with it.
Only horizontal grid on bar and line charts; no vertical grid.
A Target line always has a label (legend or annotation).
